lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using därför att to give a reason for a feeling or choice.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Casual small talk about food, energy, and lunch choices.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Giving a simple reason for a preference or decision.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss lunch options and explain why one option sounds better today.

main_focus.name: därför att for simple reasons
main_focus.description: Use därför att to explain why someone feels or chooses something.
model_examples: Jag vill äta tidigt därför att jag är hungrig.
Vi tar sallad därför att den är fräsch.
Jag väljer soppa därför att det är kallt ute.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use därför att naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic V2 word order in main clauses
basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska, måste

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use food words in a practical way and include clear reason chunks.

dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss two options and explain preferences with därför att.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose one option and move toward lunch.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat reason-giving without making every turn a reason clause

focus: the reason for the lunch decision
the practical next step after the decision

sentence_focus: one sentence choosing lunch with därför att
one sentence describing food as good or fresh
one question about what to eat
one sentence with ska for the next step
